title: Ticketed Carnival Entrance Court
description: One static ticketed carnival entrance court under the original entrance scene program. The complete open-window ticket booth stands to the left of a separate full pennant gateway; an unchanged direction sign occupies the front branching point. Three nonoverlapping scene-only paving solids distinguish the service approach, gate approach and connector, leaving the booth front and portal approach unobstructed. All three old models retain full original meshes/materials at unit scale. One scene, zero new independent models. Unlike the old fair game corner (arch and elevated ring-toss board), this is a service-to-entry threshold without a game station. Static game-art layout only: no payments, ticket operation, crowd routing, age/headroom or accessibility/safety certification.
